summary: Jefferson County Public Schools opposes any sunset or restriction of E‑Rate, argues that the program remains essential for ongoing broadband upgrades, warns that discount reductions would disproportionately burden urban districts, defends the educational‑purpose presumption, and rejects federally mandated screen‑time opt‑outs and redundant CIPA reporting. JCPS opposes federal overreach on screen‑time and content filtering, defends local autonomy, supports cybersecurity pilot inclusion, and backs consultant registration. JCPS urges stronger oversight of consultants while opposing any E‑Rate cuts, screen‑time mandates, or changes that would harm district operations.
